text:
Alex Kim: quick heads-up — holding the release lift for runtime v3.2.1 during tonight's mutation window. Deploybot raised a locklist mismatch in integration; want eyes before we clear the hold.

deploybot: automated: release_hold SET on runtime:v3.2.1 reason=SDK-signature-drift tests_failed=3/50 canary_region=eu-west

Jamie Ortiz: on it. which SDK version is drifting? do we have a minimal repro? @Priya can you sync with infra to repro? :mag:

Priya Patel: saw the failing test, looks like signature of embedding RPC changed subtly (header ordering). repro steps below:

```
# run the failing canary locally
python infra/tests/run_canary.py --model runtime:v3.2.1 --region eu-west --suite embedding-signing
```

Priya Patel: attaching logs to the PR now. preliminary guess: SDK 2.8.0 serializer path is stricter than 2.7.x.

Sara Nguyen: adding context — release notes draft mentions "improved serializer" for 2.8.x. if we pin for older SDKs we lose that perf fix. tradeoffs?

Alex Kim: tradeoff noted. proposal: keep runtime change but gate traffic by SDK-tagged routing (only SDK>=2.8.1 get v3.2.1). open a softrollout to reduce blast radius. fallback lane = runtime v3.1.9.

Jamie Ortiz: +1 to SDK-tag routing. can deploybot do tag-based routing now?

ops-bot: deploybot command accepted: create-route-rule runtime:v3.2.1 condition=sdk_version>=2.8.1 rollout=5% region=eu-west

Priya Patel: will validate the 5% canary. I'll run the signed request fuzz to ensure no drift and report back within the window.

deploybot: psuedo-check snippet if helpful:
```
curl -s -H "X-SDK-Version: 2.8.1" https://api.redwood.run/runtime/v3.2.1/health | jq '.status, .sig_check'
```

Sara Nguyen: add a line in release notes under "compatibility": "Runtime v3.2.1 requires SDK >= 2.8.1 for embedding signing. Older SDKs will be routed to v3.1.9." I'll push the blurb.

Alex Kim: rollback plan: if canary error rate >2% OR latency p99 increases >150ms for 10m, abort and route all traffic back to v3.1.9. I've updated the runbook.

Jamie Ortiz: notify support + docs about the softrollout and routing rule. tagging @support-leads.

Priya Patel: canary results: 45/50 passed after serializer tweak, two flaky signatures remain. holding until patch build for SDK 2.8.1. ETA ~45m.

Alex Kim: thanks. keeping holdlist until we confirm SDK package on pypi/npm and smoke pass in eu-west. will post final here when we lift. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
